data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Jira reconciler does not open/read/enumerate any file under scratch path; verified by targeted test that creates scratch file and asserts reconciler input set excludes it

## Description
Two-part atomic task (test + filter ship together per Gate 2):

1. Create tests/scratch/test-reconciler-scratch-exclude.sh. Fabricate tickets-tracker with sentinel files at .tickets-tracker/<valid>.json AND .tickets-tracker/.scratch/<scratch>.json. Invoke reconciler input-enumeration entry point with stub-only mode (`--dry-run-enumerate` flag to be added) that prints file list to stdout. Assert valid event present, .scratch/ path absent.

2. Audit plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/ for every directory-walk call (os.walk, Path.glob, Path.rglob, find). Add exclusion filter for any path containing a `.scratch/` component (e.g., `if '.scratch' in path.parts: continue`). Add the `--dry-run-enumerate` flag the test depends on.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Test executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scratch/test-reconciler-scratch-exclude.sh
- [ ] Reconciler test passes (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-reconciler-scratch-exclude.sh
- [ ] Reconciler filter logic excludes .scratch/
  Verify: grep -rEq "(\\.scratch'?\\s*in|/\\\\.scratch/)" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/
- [ ] Test asserts valid event present AND scratch path absent
  Verify: grep -q scratch tests/scratch/test-reconciler-scratch-exclude.sh && grep -qE '(! grep|grep -v|not in)' tests/scratch/test-reconciler-scratch-exclude.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/ | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-reconciler-scratch-exclude.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
data.title: Audit + filter Jira reconciler input set to exclude .scratch/
